channel.title: GPU Benchmark Lore
channel.description: Short two-host histories of FurMark, UNIGINE Superposition and 3DMark: the companies, the scenes and the scandals. Voices are synthetic; every episode is built from the sourced research at https://parris-tech-services.github.io/furmark-history/.

item.title: The Donut That Cooks GPUs: the story of FurMark
item.description: How a furry OpenGL donut became the program GPU makers built protections against: Catalyst name checks, the GTX 580 limiter, and FurMark 2. Two synthetic hosts, sourced from Geeks3D's own posts and changelog. Transcript and sources: https://parris-tech-services.github.io/furmark-history/read/history.html

item.title: The Professor's Lab: the story of UNIGINE Superposition
item.description: From Sanctuary and Heaven to Superposition 1.1: UNIGINE's benchmarks, the vanished professor, SSRTGI lighting and the editions. Sources: https://parris-tech-services.github.io/furmark-history/read/superposition.html

item.title: From Fire Strike to Steel Nomad: the story of 3DMark
item.description: Final Reality, 3DMark99, Futuremark's owners, one test per DirectX, and Steel Nomad's delays and scoring. Sources: https://parris-tech-services.github.io/furmark-history/read/3dmark-steel-nomad.html
